changelog: Phase G (P22-P24): Mobile PWA & Responsiveness. Installed web manifest (/manifest.webmanifest) and service worker (/sw.js) caching core app shell with offline fallback, update checking, and visible offline banner. Added Vite manualChunks code splitting for react-vendor, lucide, qrcode, and charts, with React.lazy + Suspense across all application pages for fast mobile startup. Throttled notification polling to 5 minutes with document visibility pausing, and introduced responsive card view for fee collection on mobile screens.
